component.name: Moonvibe
component.summary: Deck-first game streaming client for Sunshine, Apollo, and Vibepollo hosts

description.p: Moonvibe is a Steam Deck-focused fork of Moonlight that streams games and other applications from another PC running Sunshine, Apollo, or Vibepollo.

ul.li: Hardware accelerated video decoding with VAAPI, VDPAU, and Vulkan Video support
H.264, HEVC, and AV1 codec support, including HDR on the Steam Deck OLED
7.1 surround sound audio support
10-point multitouch support
Gamepad support with force feedback for up to 16 players
Support for both pointer capture (for games) and direct mouse control (for remote desktop)
Support for passing system-wide keyboard shortcuts like Alt+Tab to the host
Back to opening on your PCs; the home screen is gone
Menus and dialogs rebuilt on the design system

description.p: A new home screen. Moonvibe no longer opens on a list of PCs:

ul.li: Opens on what you would most likely play, across every PC
A sleeping or unpaired PC is handled by the same button, not a separate screen
Your library is a shelf underneath rather than a second screen

description.p: The Deck-first interface, rebuilt to the design:

ul.li: Library artwork now fills the tile, with the title over a scrim
Top bar carries a host pill and a clock instead of a page title
Manrope and Space Grotesk bundled for the display type
Continue row of recently played apps above the library grid
Pairing shows the PIN in large tiles with a link straight to the host web UI
Optional SteamGridDB artwork, with the host's own art as fallback
Dark OLED-first theme across the whole app
Controller glyph hint bar (A/B/X/Y) on every screen
Host cards with live status, app grid with monogram art placeholders and running badges

description.p: Initial Moonvibe fork of moonlight-qt master:

ul.li: Rebranded application identity and packaging
Steam Deck-focused Flatpak packaging with gamescope HDR support
